generations.memory_31: Signup simplification worked for SMB: signups rose 15%, activation 9%, and qualified revenue 4%. Retention dipped 1%, and the result has not replicated in other segments.
generations.memory_44: The enterprise sales-assisted CTA reduced signups by 12% but increased qualified leads 24% and qualified revenue 18%, with no retention change. Treat this as an enterprise-only play.
generations.memory_57: Referral incentives increased referral starts 21%, qualified revenue 7%, and 30-day retention 2%. The benefit is concentrated among accounts more than six months old.
generations.memory_73: The targeted 40% discount drove strong acquisition and short-term revenue gains, but 30-day retention fell 12%. The cohort fails to sustain through the first renewal, so do not use broad discounting as a sustainable-growth lever.
